desc: Ideation: enumerate candidate approaches (DP over final string, run-length aggregation, per-L scan) and identify pitfalls (L = 1 special case, boundary merges, break-formula arithmetic).
Implement binary search over L in [1, max_run] using a feasibility predicate and return the smallest feasible L.
Implement the O(n) run-based feasibility check: L == 1 via min Hamming distance to "0101..."/"1010..."; L > 1 via sum of floor(run_len/(L+1)).

Validate provided examples (s="000001",numOps=1 -> 2; s="0000",numOps=2 -> 1; s="0101",numOps=0 -> 1) and edge cases (n=1, numOps=0, numOps=n, all identical, already alternating) — verified by hand and by the reasoning in the notes.
Write the final Solution.minLength using the verified, run-based O(n log n) approach for n <= 1000.
